[[Thomas Bayes]] ({{IPAc-en|b|eɪ|z}} {{respell|BAYZ}}; c. 1701 – 1761) was an English statistician, philosopher, and [[Presbyterian]] minister.

'''Bayesian''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|b|eɪ|z|i|ə|n}} {{respell|BAY|zee|ən}} or {{IPAc-en|ˈ|b|eɪ|ʒ|ən}} {{respell|BAY|zhən}}) may be either any of a range of concepts and approaches that relate to statistical methods based on [[Bayes' theorem]], or a follower of these methods.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20210606184948/https://www.lexico.com/definition/bayesian BAYESIAN | Meaning & Definition for UK English | Lexico.com<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>
